title: cmux settings.json (plus extensions)
description: Schema fragments for cmux 'plus' fork-only settings. Referenced from cmux-settings.schema.json via $ref so plus additions stay isolated from upstream-shared schema.

sidebarPullRequestShellDebounceEnabled.description: Delay and coalesce shell-triggered sidebar pull request refreshes before checking GitHub.

sidebarPullRequestShellDebounceSeconds.description: Delay window in seconds for shell-triggered sidebar pull request refreshes.

digest.title: digest
digest.description: Workspace Digest settings from Settings > Workspace Digest.

enabled.description: Allow cmux-digest to summarize workspace state for sidebar and Radar views.

model.description: Optional CLI model name for summaries. The UI offers provider-specific presets plus a custom value.

claudeCodeModel.description: Legacy optional Claude Code model when provider is claude-code. Prefer digest.model.

currentWorkspaceMinIntervalSec.description: Minimum seconds between current workspace digest refreshes.

backgroundMinIntervalSec.description: Minimum seconds between background workspace digest refreshes.

screenLines.description: Number of recent terminal lines read per surface.

includeDiffStat.description: Include git diff statistics as trusted local context.

sendFullDiffToLLM.description: Send the full git diff to CLI-backed summaries.

writeSidebarMetadata.description: Let cmux-digest publish topic and summary through sidebar metadata.

ghpr.description: Optional PRDashboard socket integration for read-only PR context.

enabled.description: Read PRDashboard's local socket for the workspace pull request and feed the context into Workspace Digest.

socketPath.description: Unix socket path for PRDashboard. Leave empty to use /tmp/com.xiaocang.PRDashboard.<uid>.sock.

displayItems.description: Sidebar metadata items to show for the linked PR.

jiraBaseURL.description: Optional Jira base URL for clickable tickets. Use {ticket} for custom URL templates.

workspaceTab.title: workspaceTab
workspaceTab.description: Workspace tab and Summary Priority sidebar settings.

enabled.description: Enable Summary Priority ranking for workspace summaries.

scoreDisplayLocation.description: Choose whether Summary Priority scores appear in the native sidebar or in the extension column.

dimensionId.description: Dimension id used when mode is dimension.
